articles.summary: HSBC is launching a Global AI Centre of Excellence in Singapore in the second half of 2026, to develop artificial intelligence capabilities that can be scaled across its global network.

articles.summary: Investors are using AI tools to explore their options, but they rely on trusted professional advice when making financial decisions, according to HSBC research.
articles.title: AI makes investors bolder but human expertise rules at decision time

articles.title: HSBC supports International Mathematical Olympiad in Shanghai as Principal Partner
